teacher_info.introduction:
I’m a professional English Teacher from the UK. I have both the CELTA and TEFL certifications, recognised worldwide as leading qualifications to teach English as a foreign and second language. 

I’ve been a teacher for over 15 years and I have a passion to see my students go further with the skills I taught them. It’s a pleasure to hear my students say they did well in the IELTS thanks to my tutoring. 

Why should you study with me? 

I can give you insights into English culture and teach you idiomatic expressions that will make you sound natural and more like a native. 

You’re guaranteed to have: 

01. Prepared lessons with authentic, customised material with your goal in mind. 
02. Feedback in every lesson so you know which areas you need to work on. 
03. Hints and tips on how to study and prepare for international exams like the IELTS. 
04. Lessons to improve the skills you want to develop, but also improve your overall understanding and use of English. 
05. English language and culture, and tips on how to become an independent learner. 
06. An opportunity to communicate in English with a qualified native teacher who will work to help you to express yourself clearly and correctly. 

I will coach and support you every step of the way to becoming fully competent and confident to communicate in English. 

After we've established your level of English, we will discuss your needs and expectations. I’ll show you how my teaching expertise can help you become the best English speaker you can be. 

Book a lesson NOW, so we can discuss your needs and start the lessons that will make a real difference in your life and career.

pro_course_detail.description:
IELTS, CAE are tough exams for anyone, even for native speakers...even for myself if I'm not in the mood!! It requires practice to familiarise yourself with the format, lots of concentration and of course a good B2/C1 level of English...this is where I can help you to overcome those obstacles and get you through the exam...

FCE is a B2 (or Upper Intermediate exam) which is often necessary to show a good level of English at work or for higher education.  

We will follow the official IELTS,CAE and FCE books, as well as other relevant material and I will give you regular assessments of your progress by setting you old exam papers to do in your free time, as well as other homework tasks, which I will mark and return to you.

I will be very honest with you from the beginning and if I don't think you are up to scratch for the exam, I will tell you so...having said this we can work together to get you to that right level...

The IELTS and CAE exams are big mountains to conquer and familiarisation with the exam takes time. First I will introduce you to the exam format (if you don't already know it) which I think is vital in order to tackle this exam efficiently and within the time you are given to complete it. Together we can decide which area you need to work on most – this is usually 1) the writing!!! and 2) the speaking but everyone is different. 

I will share my lesson notes which I will take during the lesson, give you an assessment of your performance during the lesson and set you homework which I will mark and grade for you as part of my lesson fee. 

Part of my lesson will include PPT slides which you can also refer to after the lesson. Here I will give you useful tips on how to approach this exam and pass with flying colours.

I look forward to hearing from you...

pro_course_detail.title: English for Interviews
pro_course_detail.description:
Interview preparation course

In this course, you will practice interview techniques and a wide range of modern interview questions to help you feel confident to attend an interview in English. Whether you are preparing for an interview for a specific position or are just starting your job search, this course will enable you to feel confident and prepared on the day.

This five-lesson course is divided into the following classes:

1. Common interview questions and interview philosophy: understanding what the interviewer wants to see, as well as learning best practices for answering common questions.

2. Narrative questions: how to answer narrative questions, with plenty of practice.

3. Situational and psychological questions: understanding and answering complex situational questions.

4. CV and cover letter review: practice answering questions about your CV and cover letter, plus we will perform a grammar and spelling check of your documents.

5. Practice interview and feedback: In our final class, we will conduct a complete practice interview, and you will receive feedback on your performance.

This course is very flexible, so if you wish to practice specific questions or skills let me know. If you have any questions about this course or would like to discuss your suitability, please feel free to contact me and I will be happy to help you.

Drawing on my own experiences of leadership in corporate America, this course is not confined solely to classroom theory, and you will receive a wide variety of real-world English materials and resources that will allow you to develop your competence and confidence in a relevant and time-efficient way. 

Suitable for any business professional who is seeking to improve their language competence in a timely and engaging manner, this course is also very flexible and can be adapted to your specific circumstances. If you would like to book a class or have any questions that you would like to address first, please feel free to contact me and I will be happy to address any queries you may have.

pro_course_detail.title: English for web developers, software engineers and IT professionals
pro_course_detail.description:
This speaking course is designed to help developers, engineers and IT professionals feel confident when using their English in work environments. 

Whether you are front-end, back-end or full-stack, this course covers a wide range of IT and business topics, helping you develop the natural-sounding, fluent English you need in your career.

Included in this course:
-Business English topics essential for the modern employee or leader.
-IT topics relevant to the workplace and adapted to your role.
-Coding activities where you will practice speaking English whilst solving programming problems in a collaborative IDE (requires either Atom or VScode).
-Technology-focused classes tailored to your individual stack.
-Writing practice (if desired).

In addition, job seekers will have the opportunity to practice interview questions and techniques, both for the HR recruitment process and the technical interview. 

Some example topics from the course:
-Agile and scrum in the workplace
-The software development life-cycle
-Modern business leadership
-Managing remote teams
-Principles of system administration
-Testing and debugging
and many more.

In addition to syllabus topics, I am able to create lessons directly suited to your requirements, so if you have any particular needs please let me know. If you have any further questions about this course, feel free to contact me and I will be happy to guide you.

pro_course_detail.title: Exam English: B2 First (FCE), C1 Advanced (CAE), IELTS (bands 7,8,9)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, you will prepare for the exam of your choice with the final objective of success at either FCE, CAE or IELTS. You will practice speaking, listening, reading and writing and receive guided examination practice using authentic materials to help you achieve the results you deserve.

You will build your confidence with the language in a friendly and professional learning environment, fully supported at every step of the learning process. This course is suitable for intermediate or advanced students seeking to achieve a certificate in English; please inform the teacher of your objectives when booking a lesson, and the course will be adjusted to your level and your goals.

This course includes the option to provide writing tasks for marking (up to 250 words per class) at no additional charge.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking and writing
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course, we will work on developing your fluency by speaking about a wide range of common and less-common topics including both business and general English. 

You will gain confidence in your speaking abilities and learn to use authentic, natural-sounding English to help you with your work, studies or life.

In addition, every class you will be provided with a writing task dealing with a wide variety of writing situations. You will receive useful, constructive feedback on your written work, enabling you to improve your writing style and grammar quickly and effectively.

pro_course_detail.title: Casual Speaking Practice -   🐍🎊 New Year 2025 🐍🎊
pro_course_detail.description: Let's have some fun and get to know one another by chatting in English together. Tell me all about yourself and where you're from, what you like to do, and what you don't like to do! We can talk about anything in this free-talk style lesson. I will correct your English as much as you want me to, but let's just chat!

pro_course_detail.title: Custom Lesson - You decide what we do!  - 🐍🎊 New Year 2025 🐍🎊
pro_course_detail.description:
For this lesson slot, you can choose what we do to your specific desires. You can choose on the day, or we can plan a lesson in advance. We could look at homework or resources, we can discuss grammar, we can look at news articles, or talk about some old man jokes!

Whatever it is you need from your English teacher, I'm here to help.

pro_course_detail.title: Idioms, slang, and changing vocabulary! - TV, Movie, Music, Internet and more! 🐍🎊 New Year 2025 🐍🎊
pro_course_detail.description:
Like any language, English is always changing and growing.
In this class we will look at all things slang. Idioms, phrasal verbs, jokes and puns, music slang, TV slang, new slang, internet vocabulary, and more!
In these classes you can ask me about words you have seen or heard, or I can lead with common phrases and slang to get us started.
This lesson is designed to get you comfortable speaking and understanding natural native daily English, more than what textbooks teach.

Maybe you want to understand TV more? Or speak to native friends more casually? Or learn some fun phrases!

I also welcome any questions or topics you want to discuss.
If you've seen or heard a word or phrase, you can ask me and I will teach you.
This includes bad words. Maybe you don't know the meaning and you want to make sure you are using or hearing words correctly.  It is important to know these words so you know how to use them, and how they are being used towards you! I will be respectful and professional when discussing rude words.

Join me in learning more English and having fun with it!

pro_course_detail.title: Trials - For students who used italki's 3 trial lessons.
pro_course_detail.description:
Here you can purchase a trial lesson!
italki offers 3 trial lessons to students, but sometimes you need another!
Here you can book a trial with me and not need an italki trial.
In the class we will talk and get to know each other!  I will ask you questions about your skills and goals and together we can plan how to improve!

If you have questions, let me know!

pro_course_detail.title: SAT English - Question Analysis (English only, not test strategy)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class we can go over questions specifically designed around the SAT.
I will aim to help you understand the complex levels of English between different answer choices in a test that can be very confusing, even for natives.
I have experience in teaching and designing test preparation lessons for the SAT but I am not an expert in SAT test strategies. I can help understand aspects of the SAT test and decipher the English and confusing answer choices that use high level or obscure language rules.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic English Practice and Advice (TOEFL based)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class we will practice academic English skills useful for TOEFL, IELTS, EIKEN, GTEC, and more.
We will use academic, mostly TOEFL, style questions and activities to practice your answers. I will adjust the lesson for the test where I can.
I will give advice on academic wording and phrasing and grammar as a native would understand your answers for the test.

Disclaimer: I am not affiliated with or endorsed by any test company. I do have years of experience helping students with these tests.
